title: curvature.native spec
description: What a curvature.native request asks for: an engine's own field curves of a system whose object is at infinity, at each requested line, the tangential and the sagittal focus of the field of each angle in object space, degrees, in the meridional plane, an object toward +y. maxFieldDeg is the half field the angles are of, which an engine that states its fields as fractions of a half field takes for it. Code checks that the lines are distinct and that every angle is at most maxFieldDeg.

lines.description: Indices of lines of the case, in conditions.lines, each once.

maxFieldDeg.description: The half field the angles are of, degrees.

fieldAnglesDeg.description: The field angle of each field, degrees, in the order the answer lists them within a line.
